front: Define time series in one sentence.
back: Values of one measure at different times, kept in time order. Order carries information and neighbors are related.

front: Cross-sectional vs time series vs panel?
back: Cross-sectional: many things, one moment. Time series: one thing, many moments. Panel: many things, many moments.
Regular: equal time steps (every hour). Irregular: unequal steps, like event logs. Aggregate irregular data to fixed buckets.

front: Why is a random train/test split wrong for time series?
back: Rows are related to their neighbors, so training rows can come after test rows. The model sees the future. Split by time.

front: Three quick checks on a new series?
back: Is the index sorted? Is it unique (no duplicate dates)? Are any steps missing?
